description: Browse the catalog's genre vocabulary: each genre with how many catalog editions carry it and up to four covered editions for a cover mosaic. This is an anonymous catalog read served by the bibliograph edge from the catalog tables; it is never handled by HappyView. Rows are ordered by edition count, then name.
